t.why: Phosphate mining once made it rich, but the resource has run out. It switched recognition from Taiwan to China in 2024.
t.rel: One of the smallest island countries in the world. It has run an Australian refugee detention center and in 2024 switched recognition from Taiwan to China.
t.know: It has no official capital. In 2026 it changed its name from Nauru back to its native name, Naoero.
t.etext: After its phosphate ran out it lost its main income; fees for running Australia's refugee detention center and fishing rights are now its main revenue.
